hook.name: StonkHookV4
hook.description: A token launchpad hook for Robinhood Chain that gates swaps to an ERC-20-enforced trading window (NYSE hours), applies dynamic fees with an anti-snipe surcharge that decays over three seconds post-launch, and withholds asset-leg fees as ERC-6909 claims split among liquidity, creator, protocol, and treasury. Liquidity removals are permanently blocked; the liquidity fee share is placed as one-sided resting bids below spot, funding a perpetual price floor.
